rule-or-reason.notes: Rule Or Reason 0.2.0 from the local canonical non-Git snapshot (identical to isolated build commit 2dc74ab). Adds the schema-v2 study helper (obligation-map checks, selective cascade accounting, threshold seal, provenance exclusions, blind packets, Wilson/exact McNemar/Newcombe bounds, four scoped verdicts), discovery and lifetime templates, and 39 new tests; the v1 helper and its 20 tests are unchanged. scripts/controls.py.reason: The canonical control runner hard-codes the creation machine's research folder as the only allowed output root (a machine path and a portability defect). The public copy allows a new directory under the current working directory instead, but rejects any output inside the skill package, because the runner copies the package for each mutant and an output beneath it would be copied into itself (review finding on PR #6). The guard against reusing an existing directory and every other line are unchanged. No test invokes this runner. The next source version should make the root portable, which will make this overlay unnecessary.
